payer.description: VID of the party undertaking to settle.

payee.description: VID of the party to be paid.

amount.description: Decimal amount as a string (avoids float precision loss).

conditions.description: Conditions of release; opaque strings whose interpretation is shared between the parties.

tolerance.description: ISO 8601 duration within which settlement must occur.

settlementAgent.description: Optional VID of a settlement agent involved in the transaction.
